trainingAlgorithm: Paired complete-graph reward search. Incumbent and two candidates share starting conditions. Maximize safe landings, then mean shaped reward. Mixed courses use three profiles per batch; single profiles use two seeds.
perturbationLineage: Original v5: pilot 0.12 generations 1–3 then 0.015; specialists 0.12 generation 1 then 0.015. Expanded curriculum: 0.015 for six generations per landing family; engine-out generations 9–14 and orbital generations 1–2 use 0.06 correlated head gain plus 0.008 coefficient noise.

limitations: Two held-out seeds per profile form a small simulator evaluation, not a reliability guarantee. All failures are included.
The world and vehicle are stylized; orbital distances and periods are compressed.
Orbital trajectory/attitude/thrust cues are engineered from simulator state. The neural readout tracks that guidance; this is not a learned orbital planner.
Readouts were initialized from demonstrations before full-network reward training.
Individual biological synapse counts and signs are fixed; output readout weights learn.
A simplified signed-rate network is not a validated biological fly emulation.
